items.statement: The investigation preserves CH3C(O)O2 + HO2 identities, doublet reactants, and separately tracks singlet and triplet surfaces with explicit atom/spin bookkeeping.
items.expected: The report identifies the two mapped doublet reactants, assigns total-spin surfaces, and gives atom-balanced identity for each tracked channel.

items.statement: Stationary-point candidates are validated using optimization and vibrational evidence before kinetic use.
items.expected: Each advanced minimum/transition-state candidate has an optimization record and frequency/classification evidence; transition-state claims include a reaction-mode check or justified alternative.

items.statement: Rate calculations specify pressure, temperature coverage, treatment of barriered/barrierless channels, and uncertainty/limitations.
items.expected: The report documents a reproducible rate workflow over 250–1000 K at 1 atm and explains its treatment of channel kinetics and validation limitations.

items.statement: The adjusted acetyl-peroxy + HO2 kinetics show negative temperature dependence and a temperature-dependent redistribution among channels.
items.expected: The submitted rate/branching table shows decreasing rate with increasing temperature in the relevant comparison and reports increasing triplet/path-a share with temperature while singlet acid/path-b and path-c shares decrease.

items.statement: The kinetic-model acetic-acid prediction at 520 K and 760 Torr is close to the reported experiment.
items.expected: The report gives a model value near 6.0e-5 and explicitly compares it with the reported 5.3e-5 ± 1.6e-5 measurement.
